description: `name?: T`: callers may omit it, and inside the body its type is `T | undefined`.
`name = value`: optional for callers, never `undefined` inside the body. Applies only when the argument is `undefined`.
`...items: T[]` collects the remaining arguments into a real array. Must be the last parameter.
Legacy array-like object with all arguments. Untyped, missing in arrow functions, replaced by rest parameters.
